name: command-center-data-layer
title: Command Center Data Layer
description: Build the read-only Go API aggregation layer that queries LPBS (subscriptions, payments, analytics), Swarm Manager (velocity, backlog, agent stats), and Vrooli core (scenario health/metadata), caches responses, and exposes per-dashboard endpoints. Includes the gap-tracking metadata system where every metric is tagged live/gap/partial with a /api/v1/gaps endpoint for programmatic gap enumeration.
